Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1:1 fantasy RPG inventory item illustration: the elegant late-medieval clothing ensemble "Perlenversprechen" from Göttliche Eleganz. The written garment description below defines the exact design, materials and colors. Both attached armor references define ONLY the illustration style, never their armor design, symbols or colors. Reference 2 defines the ITEM ART STYLE only: hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, painterly textured metal, leather, wood and cloth, crisp dark outlines, soft simplified shading, muted warm colors, gentle illustrated highlights, readable details and a clear silhouette at small thumbnail size. Not photorealistic, not CGI or a glossy 3D render. Follow the written clothing design. Do not copy armor, heraldic creatures, plate metal or house emblems from either reference. Show the entire isolated object, centered and large within the square, with about 10% clear margin on all sides. Slight three-quarter view where appropriate; long weapons may run diagonally from lower-left handle to upper-right tip. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; at most a very faint soft BLACK contact shadow immediately beneath the object. No living person, hands, face, scenery, floor, pedestal, frame, text, watermark or painted checkerboard. A plain WHITE tailor mannequin is specifically required by the user. Do not add unrelated objects.
Use case: stylized-concept. The ATTACHED ARMOR IMAGES ARE STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their hand-painted fantasy INVENTORY art: bold crisp dark contours, subtly textured cloth, simplified warm shading, readable crafted details. If a THIRD clothing reference is attached, it defines ONLY the white headless mannequin, compact torso framing and presentation; do NOT copy its garment design or colors. NOT anime portrait art, NOT a photograph or realistic shop mannequin render.
GARMENT DESIGN (binding): Hochzeitsgarnitur mit kurzem silbergrauem Mantel. Materials: Perlgraue Seide · Silberfaden · Kleine Süßwasserperlen. Perlgraue Seide und ein kreidehelles Wams geben dieser Garnitur eine kühle, lichte Wirkung. Der flach gefaltete Kragen und die schmalen Ärmel tragen feine silbergestickte Myrtenzweige. Ein kurzer silbergrauer Mantel ruht auf beiden Schultern; zwei kleine Süßwasserperlen sitzen an seiner flachen Silberschließe. Der Mantel wird zum Tanz abgenommen, während die gestickte Wamsfront vollständig bleibt. Hemd und hellgraue Hose sind in die Anprobe einbezogen. Die Perlenfassungen werden glatt unterlegt, damit Metall und Stickerei den Stoff nicht aufreiben. Visible relevant details: Echte Silberstickerei mit Myrtenzweigen; Silberschließe mit zwei kleinen Süßwasserperlen; Abnehmbarer Mantel und vollständige Unterkleidung. Argentisch-Cenyrisch fashion: late-medieval Italian elegance combined with northern Cenyr tailoring. These are CLOTHES, no armor.
PRESENTATION (user instruction): One single garment ensemble worn on a simple solid MATTE WHITE HEADLESS TAILOR MANNEQUIN, a half-body torso ending just below the hips. Masculine tailoring form; show the complete upper garment and the matching TROUSER WAIST and short upper-hip trouser section beneath it. No long trouser legs. White neck stump visible inside the collar, no head or face. Sleeves hang naturally at the sides, no posed arms or hands. No exposed human skin. No anatomical legs, lower legs, feet, shoes or boots. No pedestal or visible support pole. A compact upper-body inventory object, no full-body figure. Slight three-quarter view, shoulders and entire sleeves comfortably inside the square, large centered object with 10% transparent margin. Any cloak is draped compactly around shoulders and hips. Keep the garment fully readable at thumbnail size, vary the tailoring according to this design. TRUE transparent PNG alpha outside the clothing and mannequin, including open gaps. No ground shadow, aura, white outline, labels or extra props.
